# Failure patterns

[Project overview](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Diagnostics for recurring CAD, electrical-parity and packaging failures.

[Geometry and parity](geometry-and-parity.md) collects known symptoms. New incidents belong in the [inbox](../inbox/README.md) with enough evidence to distinguish a real correction from a passing but irrelevant check.
